summary: Regression tested Expo web UI at 390x844 and 375x667 plus authenticated backend contracts. Login, tabs, playlist creation, provider-backed settings UI, sleep timer, theme toggle, and service health passed. The mini-player is intentionally non-interactive while Settings is active, so it cannot open the player sheet from Settings.
action_items: Retest full player open/close and logout in a fresh authenticated browser context; the first attempt began in the signed-out state after the previous test context was cleared.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend contract test initially depended on EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL while the review brief names EXPO_BACKEND_URL; the deployed frontend environment currently provides EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and the contract passed when that configured value was exported.
Provider catalog/audio adapter remains intentionally unavailable until a real endpoint and key are supplied; no mock API was observed.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (core flows passed; player/logout continuation was not completed in the second fresh context)

seed_data_creation: Contract test created a TEST_-prefixed user and provider configuration; no production user was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 verified login at 390x844, all bottom tabs, local playlist creation, Settings provider fields/save state, 30m sleep timer at 375x667, theme toggle, and backend health/auth/me/provider/home/search/logout. Settings sets mini-player pointerEvents to none by design.
rca_of_issue: The attempted player-sheet assertion from Settings failed because MainApp explicitly renders the mini-player with pointerEvents=none when tab === Settings. This matches the prior requested fix preventing the fixed mini-player from covering sleep timer controls, and is not a functional defect. A separate fresh browser context then started signed out, preventing completion of the player/logout continuation without repeating login.
